findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "join_waitlist" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Opens the WebWeaver Nexus waitlist signup form. Users can submit their details to join the early-access list." → after: "Opens the WebWeaver Nexus contact form. Use it to secure a priority booking for the "AI-Ready" Discovery & Audit, or enquire about a particular service."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
